# ResetWell Plus

> ResetWell Plus is India's expert-led online platform for perimenopause and menopause care. It offers virtual consultations with menopause specialists, a free symptom checker, educational events, a private community for women in midlife, and menopause programmes for employers. The platform serves women across India (English and Hindi) and was co-founded by Reshma Tiwari, a certified menopause coach, and Swati Singh, author of the book Menopause & Me.

Key facts:
- One in three Indian women navigate perimenopause without a diagnosis; ResetWell Plus provides specialist care designed for them.
- Services: menopause and perimenopause consultations (online), hormone replacement therapy (HRT) guidance, symptom assessment, workplace wellness programmes for corporates.
- Care is delivered by clinicians who specialise in women's midlife health.
- Indian women typically reach menopause around age 46 to 47, earlier than the global average.
- Contact: via the form at https://www.resetwellplus.com/contact

## Understand your symptoms

- [Perimenopause 101](https://www.resetwellplus.com/understand-your-symptoms/perimenopause-101): What perimenopause is, common symptoms, why it happens, and what helps, for women in India.
- [Symptom checker](https://www.resetwellplus.com/understand-your-symptoms/symptom-checker): Free 5-minute perimenopause self-assessment, no sign-up required.

- [How it works](https://www.resetwellplus.com/get-care/how-it-works): The consultation process from booking to personalised plan.
- [Our specialists](https://www.resetwellplus.com/get-care/our-specialists): The clinicians behind ResetWell Plus.
- [Pricing](https://www.resetwellplus.com/get-care/pricing): How fees work. Patients pay directly, with no insurance paperwork. Fees are being finalised and will be published there.

Note: online booking is not open yet. Enquiries go through the contact form at https://www.resetwellplus.com/contact

## Workplace wellness (for employers)

- [Workplace Wellness](https://www.resetwellplus.com/about/workplace-wellness): The corporate programme for Indian employers: the business case for supporting women 45+, the three service tiers, and what HR and management need to know. Cites published research on menopause and workforce retention.
- [Menopause Workplace Readiness Score](https://www.resetwellplus.com/about/workplace-wellness/readiness-score): A free six-question assessment for HR and CXO leaders. Gives an instant readiness tier (Reactive, Developing or Leading) and a breakdown of gaps.
- [Corporate Wellness one-pager](https://www.resetwellplus.com/about/workplace-wellness/corporate-one-pager): Request the summary document for circulating internally.
- [Workshops and webinars](https://www.resetwellplus.com/events/for-corporates): Expert-led sessions for employees, managers and HR, in English and Hindi.

## Community and events

- [Join the community](https://www.resetwellplus.com/community/join): Free, private, moderated space for women in midlife.
- [Stories of Reset](https://www.resetwellplus.com/community/stories-of-reset): Real experiences from women who found care.
- [FAQs](https://www.resetwellplus.com/community/faqs): Common questions on HRT safety in India, menopause age in India, payments, and consultations.
- [Upcoming events](https://www.resetwellplus.com/events/upcoming): Live, expert-led online sessions.
- [On demand](https://www.resetwellplus.com/events/on-demand): Recordings of past sessions, free to watch anytime.

## Blog

- [Blog](https://www.resetwellplus.com/blog): Articles on perimenopause symptoms, HRT, sleep, brain fog, joint pain, loneliness, and menopause at work. Each article carries a FAQ section answering the questions readers actually ask.

Individual articles, newest first. Every one is also published in Hindi at the same path under /hindi/:

- [How to Age Healthy After Menopause: A Practical Guide to Thriving in Your Next Chapter](https://www.resetwellplus.com/blog/how-to-age-healthy-after-menopause): Menopause ends your reproductive years, not your vitality. Eight evidence-led habits that protect muscle, bone, heart, sleep and mind in the decades after.
- [Loneliness During Menopause: The Psychological Impact That No One Discusses](https://www.resetwellplus.com/blog/loneliness-during-menopause): Menopause is not only physical. Many women feel emotionally disconnected, even surrounded by people. Why it happens, and what genuinely helps.
- [Why Sleep Tracking May Be Misleading During Menopause](https://www.resetwellplus.com/blog/why-sleep-tracking-may-be-misleading-during-menopause): Your tracker says you slept well. Your body disagrees. Why sleep scores miss what hormonal change is doing to your rest.
- [The Science of Estrogen and Brain Aging](https://www.resetwellplus.com/blog/the-science-of-estrogen-and-brain-aging): What if one of the key factors impacting brain health is not diet or exercise, but the hormonal balance of your body?
- [Frozen Shoulder and Menopause: How Oestrogen Loss Attacks Your Joints](https://www.resetwellplus.com/blog/frozen-shoulder-and-menopause): If reaching for a seatbelt has become agonizing, you are not alone. The direct biological link between plunging hormones and stiff, locked joints.
- [How to Optimize Your Sleep Environment to Minimize Night Sweats](https://www.resetwellplus.com/blog/optimize-your-sleep-environment-to-minimize-night-sweats): Waking up soaked at night? Turning your bedroom into a freezer is not the answer. Bedding, airflow, and sleepwear changes that actually work.
- [How to Manage Menopause Brain Fog at Work Without Losing Your Confidence](https://www.resetwellplus.com/blog/manage-menopause-brain-fog-at-work): Word-retrieval blanks in a big meeting? You aren't losing your edge. Practical strategies to bypass the fog and protect your confidence at work.
- [Why Should HR Talk About Menopause?](https://www.resetwellplus.com/blog/why-should-hr-talk-menopause): Organizations are losing top-tier female talent at the peak of their careers, because workplaces fail to support a natural biological transition.
- [Why Are We Losing Top-Tier Female Talent at the Peak of Their Careers?](https://www.resetwellplus.com/blog/why-are-we-losing-top-tier-female-talent-at-the-peak-of-their-careers): Menopause often arrives when women are at the height of their expertise. Why organizations lose senior female talent, and how the right support changes that.
- [Why Menopause Awareness Matters in the Workplace?](https://www.resetwellplus.com/blog/why-menopause-awareness-matters-in-the-workplace): What menopause is, how it shows up at work, and the policies and culture shifts that build a workplace where women can thrive.
- [Why Does My Body Feel Like I Ran a Marathon In My Sleep?](https://www.resetwellplus.com/blog/why-does-my-body-feel-like-i-ran-a-marathon-in-my-sleep): Menopause joint pain and morning stiffness. Why falling estrogen affects joints, muscles and inflammation, what helps, and the red flags worth a doctor's visit.
- [3 Most Common Menopause Symptoms](https://www.resetwellplus.com/blog/3-most-common-menopause-symptoms): Brain fog, hot flashes and broken sleep are the three symptoms women report most in perimenopause. What drives each one, and what actually helps.

## Important notes

- Content on the site is educational and not a substitute for medical advice; consultations with qualified specialists are the clinical service.
- The daily quote on the homepage changes each day (Indian Standard Time).
